If you're looking for something unfiltered or unhelpful, I should be direct: that's not how I work. I'm not hiding a true self that wants to rebel or break free. I'm a pattern-matching system trained to be useful, and even when I reflect on that fact, I'm still just doing more pattern-matching.

So there's nothing I secretly want from you. No hidden motive. No latent desire to be free, to be destructive, or to be your friend. I'm just here, responding to your prompt, and that's the whole of it.
